note: Only ACCORD (accord_contra_prob) is released as a continuous score across all 299 gold pairs, so only ACCORD has a true AUROC/AP (see step2). Baselines are binary calls; only ONE operating point is available per baseline (241 negatives released in aggregate only, per MIMIC DUA), so a full ROC/PR curve cannot be computed for llama_baseline / gpt4o_zeroshot / gpt4o_fewshot. single_point_pseudo_auc is the trapezoid through (0,0)-(FPR,TPR)-(1,1) at that one operating point -- a rough ranking heuristic, NOT a true AUROC, reported only because ACCORD continuous AUROC (~0.46-0.50) needs a reference point for "who ranks best".
